Name: Pattern
Description: Specifies the halftone pattern or dithering algorithm used to convert a black and white map into halftone shading. Each pattern produces a distinct visual effect, simulating various print or screen halftone styles.

Flubs.Name: FloydSteinberg
Flubs.Description: Applies Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion dithering, producing a classic, high-quality halftone effect with smooth gradients.

Flubs.Name: Riemersma
Flubs.Description: Uses Riemersma dithering, which distributes error along a space-filling curve for a unique, less directional halftone appearance.

Flubs.Name: Threshold
Flubs.Description: Applies a simple threshold to the input, converting pixels above a certain value to white and below to black, resulting in a stark, high-contrast halftone.

Flubs.Name: Checks
Flubs.Description: Creates a checkerboard halftone pattern, alternating black and white squares to simulate shading.

Flubs.Name: O2X2
Flubs.Description: Uses a 2x2 ordered dithering matrix to create a small, repeating halftone pattern.

Flubs.Name: O3X3
Flubs.Description: Uses a 3x3 ordered dithering matrix for a slightly larger, repeating halftone pattern.

Flubs.Name: O4X4
Flubs.Description: Uses a 4x4 ordered dithering matrix, producing a more detailed and less repetitive halftone effect.

Flubs.Name: O8X8
Flubs.Description: Applies an 8x8 ordered dithering matrix for fine, detailed halftone shading with minimal visible repetition.

Flubs.Name: H3X4A
Flubs.Description: Applies a 3x4 halftone matrix (variant A), creating a specific dot arrangement for stylized halftone effects.

Flubs.Name: H6X6A
Flubs.Description: Uses a 6x6 halftone matrix (variant A) for a larger, more complex dot pattern.

Flubs.Name: H8X8A
Flubs.Description: Applies an 8x8 halftone matrix (variant A), generating a dense and detailed halftone texture.

Flubs.Name: H3X4O
Flubs.Description: Uses a 3x4 halftone matrix (variant O), offering an alternative dot arrangement for different visual results.

Flubs.Name: H6X6O
Flubs.Description: Applies a 6x6 halftone matrix (variant O), producing a unique halftone pattern with distinct dot placement.

Flubs.Name: H8X8O
Flubs.Description: Uses an 8x8 halftone matrix (variant O), providing a dense and alternative halftone style.

Flubs.Name: H36X16O
Flubs.Description: Applies a large 36x16 halftone matrix (variant O), creating a very fine and complex halftone pattern.

Flubs.Name: C5X5B
Flubs.Description: Uses a 5x5 circular halftone matrix with black dots, simulating traditional print halftone screens.

Flubs.Name: C5X5W
Flubs.Description: Uses a 5x5 circular halftone matrix with white dots, inverting the typical halftone dot style.

Flubs.Name: C6X6B
Flubs.Description: Applies a 6x6 circular halftone matrix with black dots for a slightly larger dot pattern.

Flubs.Name: C6X6W
Flubs.Description: Uses a 6x6 circular halftone matrix with white dots, providing an inverted halftone effect.

Flubs.Name: C7X7B
Flubs.Description: Applies a 7x7 circular halftone matrix with black dots, creating a larger, more pronounced dot pattern.

Flubs.Name: C7X7W
Flubs.Description: Uses a 7x7 circular halftone matrix with white dots, offering a bold, inverted halftone style.

Flubs.Name: DIA
Flubs.Description: Creates a halftone pattern using diagonal lines, simulating shading with slanted, evenly spaced lines.
